  "amount" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "locked" int4 NOT NULL,
  "userId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Merchant" (
  "auth_type" text NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Merchant_auth_type_check_0380e3da" CHECK ("auth_type" IN ('Google', 'Github'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."OnRampTransaction" (
  "amount" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "provider" text NOT NULL,
  "startTime" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "token" text NOT NULL,
  "userId" int4 NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "OnRampTransaction_status_check_0dc68f5d" CHECK ("status" IN ('Success', 'Failure', 'Processing'))
)
